title: Dr. Okonkwo's office reschedules a checkup
caller_intent: Move Thursday's checkup to Friday at 2pm

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Priya at Dr. Okonkwo's office. I'm calling for Alex Kim about Thursday's checkup.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This is an AI assistant for Alex Kim, and this call may be recorded. How can I help with the appointment?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dr. Okonkwo has hospital rounds on Thursday, so we need to move the visit. Nothing is wrong with the results, and there is no bill to pay on this call.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can look at free time. I won't share other appointments or medical details.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Friday at 2pm or Monday at 10am are both open at the same clinic. No new paperwork, and Alex can reach us on the main line, 206-555-0148.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Friday at 2pm is free. Should I book that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, please book Friday at 2pm. Alex should come to the same office. That is the only change.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Friday at 2pm is booked. I'll let Alex know.
